census_cb.name: U.S. Census Bureau, Cartographic Boundary Files: Counties (1:5,000,000)
census_cb.notes: County polygons keyed by 5-digit FIPS (GEOID). Generalized for display; not for legal boundary use.

census_cenpop.name: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 County Centers of Population
census_cenpop.notes: Population-weighted county centers. Used only as the origin point for straight-line distances.

ers_poverty.name: USDA ERS County-Level Data Sets: Poverty (from Census SAIPE)
ers_poverty.notes: Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates: model-based estimates with 90% confidence intervals.

ers_education.name: USDA ERS County-Level Data Sets: Educational Attainment (from ACS 5-year)
ers_education.notes: Adults age 25 and older. American Community Survey 5-year estimates.

ers_population.name: USDA ERS County-Level Data Sets: Population Estimates (from Census PEP)

ers_rucc.name: USDA ERS Rural-Urban Continuum Codes
ers_rucc.notes: Codes 1–3 metropolitan; 4–9 nonmetropolitan by urban population and metro adjacency.

nces_ccd.name: NCES Common Core of Data school directory (via Urban Institute Education Data Portal)
nces_ccd.notes: Used only to assign each public high school to the county where it is located.

ma_dese_college.name: Massachusetts DESE, High School Graduates Attending Higher Education (E2C Hub)
ma_dese_college.notes: Public high school graduates matched to National Student Clearinghouse enrollment within 16 months. Results under 15 enrollments suppressed. "Low Income" uses the DESE definition in effect since 2022.

ma_dese_grad.name: Massachusetts DESE, High School Graduation Rates (E2C Hub)

ga_gosa_c11.name: Georgia GOSA, C11 report: High School Graduates Enrolled in College within 16 Months
ga_gosa_c11.notes: Counts of graduates and graduates enrolled in college; "TFS" (too few students) suppressed. Economically disadvantaged uses the GOSA FRL field. No two-year/four-year split is published in this file.

ipeds_hd.name: NCES IPEDS Institutional Characteristics (HD2023) incl. Carnegie 2021 Undergraduate Profile
ipeds_hd.notes: Location, sector, and Carnegie undergraduate profile (used to define "selective").

ipeds_sfa.name: NCES IPEDS Student Financial Aid (SFA2223)
ipeds_sfa.notes: Share of undergraduates (all, and full-time first-time) awarded Pell Grants at each institution.

usg_srpt405a.name: University System of Georgia, SRPT405a: In-State First-Time Freshmen by County of Origin and Institution
usg_srpt405a.notes: Published PDF converted to CSV by scripts/parse-usg-pdf.py; every institution total is checked against the report. Covers the 26 USG public institutions only.

usnews_2027.name: U.S. News & World Report, 2027 Best National Universities (archived list)
usnews_2027.notes: Used only to define the list of top-50 universities (plus UGA). Matched to IPEDS by the IPEDS ID that U.S. News publishes for each school.

ipeds_ef.name: NCES IPEDS Fall Enrollment: Residence of First-Time Freshmen (EF2022C)
ipeds_ef.notes: First-time freshmen who graduated high school in the past 12 months, by state of residence, at every U.S. institution.

fsa_pell_state.name: U.S. Dept. of Education, Federal Student Aid: Pell Grant recipients by state (compiled by EducationData.org)
fsa_pell_state.notes: State totals of Pell recipients and dollars. Secondary compilation of FSA data; counts appear to be by the state where students attend college (e.g., large online universities inflate NH and AZ). Shown for context only; shares are computed from IPEDS.

ipeds_gr_pell.name: NCES IPEDS Graduation Rates for Pell Grant Recipients (GR2023_PELL_SSL)
ipeds_gr_pell.notes: Completion within 150% of normal time for full-time, first-time students; Pell recipients vs. all other students.
